summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 28, 2026, in Hong Kong. All 23 resolutions were passed, including routine items such as receiving the annual report, electing directors, reappointing the auditor, and renewing authorities to allot shares and repurchase own shares. No special situation event — such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review — is described. The filing merely discloses standard corporate governance outcomes. As a non-US issuer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a U.S. Form 8-K for reporting AGM results. There are no deal terms or risk-arb considerations.
